sources.title: Myth of Empires V1.0 Dedicated Servers Setup Guide (official) - "Enable Remote Management: Default is enabled; allows remote management using tools like RCON"; GM accounts are Steam IDs

Myth of Empires Dedicated Server Guide (OUTDATED) - Steam guide; RCON via -ShutDownServicePort/-ShutDownServiceIP/-ShutDownServiceKey, commands ShutdownServer, SaveWorld, KickOff <SteamID>, SetBlackList <SteamID> True/False, GetPlayers

Myth of Empires Rough Stand-Alone setup Guide - Steam guide; maps the server tool's Remote Management IP/Port/Password fields to -bStartShutDownServiceInPrivateServer=true -ShutDownServiceIP -ShutDownServicePort=13888 -ShutDownServiceKey
Myth Of Empires | Admin Commands - Ascend Servers knowledgebase - "cheat KickOff <SteamID64>", cheat SetAdmin/GotoPlayer/PullPlayer/KillPlayer take SteamID64
Myth of Empires Admin Commands - Survival Servers wiki - lists ShutdownServer / Cheat SaveWorld / Cheat GetPlayers as the RCON commands and notes Cheat Say only logs and GetPlayers shows no output
Myth of Empires: Cheats & Console Commands - "Cheat Say <Text> - Logs text (doesn't display in-game)", "Cheat GetPlayers - no visible output"
How to ban or unban a player on your Myth of Empires game server - GTXGaming (contradicting article: players / addban GUID / loadbans / bans / removeban #)
Myth of Empires Dedicated Server (App 1794810) - SteamDB

notes: The developer calls the remote channel "Remote Management" and states it "allows remote management using tools like RCON"; in the server tool and .bat it is the ShutDownService: -bStartShutDownServiceInPrivateServer=true, -ShutDownServiceIP, -ShutDownServicePort (13888 in the published example), -ShutDownServiceKey (the RCON password; an old guide reports the stock key 123456 - change it). No default port is published: the official guide only says Game/Query/Remote Management ports must each be unique and in 1024-65535. WIRE PROTOCOL IS UNDOCUMENTED, so rcon.flavour is deliberately omitted: no source states whether the ShutDownService speaks Valve Source RCON framing (likely, given the ARK-derived UE4 codebase and the fact that host panels expose a generic RCON web console for it) or its own dialect. Probe before assuming. Moderation is by SteamID64 throughout - GM accounts are set with -ServerAdminAccounts=<SteamID64>, and every player-targeting command in the published lists takes a SteamID64. Kick is the best-supported command: the dedicated-server guide lists "KickOff <SteamID>" among the RCON commands and the Ascend/Citadel knowledgebases list the in-game form "cheat KickOff <SteamID64>" (prefix with "cheat " if the bare form is rejected). BAN IS SINGLE-SOURCED AND HEDGED: only the Steam dedicated-server guide documents it, as "SetBlackList <SteamID> True/False - Sets Ban...allegedly" - its own author was unsure it works, so treat kick as reliable and verify ban/unban against a live server before trusting it. GTXGaming's ban article disagrees completely (players / addban <GUID> / loadbans / bans / removeban #<n>); that command set matches no other Myth of Empires source, uses a GUID rather than a Steam ID, and looks like boilerplate copied from another title, so it is recorded as disagreement, not adopted. NO listPlayers RECORDED ON PURPOSE: the only roster command published is GetPlayers (in-game "cheat GetPlayers"), and every source that mentions it says it returns no visible output, with the dedicated-server guide reporting it "throws memory errors and crashes the server" - so the roster must come from the Steam query port, not from the console. NO say RECORDED: "Cheat Say <Text>" is documented by several independent pages as writing to the log only and not displaying to players, i.e. a command that exists but does nothing useful as a broadcast; in-game GMs announce through the Server Settings panel instead. No MOTD or info/status command is published. Other RCON commands seen: ShutdownServer, SaveWorld. Confidence is low: the transport and its settings are corroborated by the developer plus two independent guides, but the ban/unban text rests on one hedged source and the RCON dialect is unconfirmed.
